title: ModelInterface/v1
description: A typed interface to a scientific model: the kind of model (ode, dae, sde, pde_variational, discrete_map, statistical_model, or composition), the symbol_ids it exposes (state variables, parameters, inputs, outputs), the governing equations as MathIR references, an optional ConditionSet reference stating its assumptions, and a composition list referencing sub-model interfaces (empty when the model is atomic). The symbol_ids and interface references are logical identifiers resolved against SymbolTable/v1 and other ModelInterface/v1 objects at the fabric level. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

interface_id.description: Stable logical identifier for the interface (referenced by other interfaces' composition lists). Not a content hash; identity of a ModelInterface object is its envelope object_id.

kind.description: The model class. An atomic model selects ode/dae/sde/pde_variational/discrete_map/statistical_model; a composite model selects 'composition' and references its parts via the composition list.

state_variables.description: symbol_ids of the state variables (evolving quantities). Empty for a purely statistical model.

parameters.description: symbol_ids of the model parameters (fixed-for-a-run quantities).

inputs.description: symbol_ids of the model inputs (exogenous drivers).

outputs.description: symbol_ids of the model outputs (observed/returned quantities).

governing.description: References (object_ids) to the MathIR/v1 objects carrying the governing equations. Empty when the interface is purely declarative.

assumptions.description: A reference (object_id) to a ConditionSet/v1 object stating the model's assumptions, or omitted when none are declared.

composition.description: interface_ids of the sub-models, for kind='composition'. Empty when the model is atomic.
